rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the plan adds fields and gates to owners that are already deep (nova/equilibrium/stencil_nulls.py::critical_point_candidates_batch is the single batch kernel for candidate generation, hiding degree, stencil fit and overflow behind one call; nova/equilibrium/topology.py owns admission) and proposes no new module that wraps them.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the per-producer banking emission in §1 would duplicate the shared owner benchmarks/diiid_forward_gs_match.py:716 (banked_read_summary) / :669 (candidate_flux_margins), and §4's joint certificate qualification re-derives topology admission that nova/equilibrium/topology.py:216 (require_qualified_axis) and the terminal read's read_qualification already own.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — §1 names three producers to extend for the stationary-point banking fields without citing the existing shared owner, benchmarks/diiid_forward_gs_match.py::banked_read_summary (line 716) with candidate_flux_margins (line 669), which already emits every listed field (nova axis/X-point positions and flux, reference counterpart, admitted O/X counts, second-best flux margin, read status with exception text) and is already imported by two of the three producers solovev_certificate.py:38 and efit_topology_corroboration.py:26.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: a finding — the change §1 describes is an emission adapter and the adapter already exists as banked_read_summary, which takes the per-row reference counterparts as parameters; adding a per-producer field set adds serialization surface without new behaviour.
